The petitioner, vide the present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) (erstwhile Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks quashing of FIR No.329/2021 dated 28.06.2021 registered at PS Shahbad Dairy, Delhi under Sections 498A/406/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

Since four other persons, who are named in the FIR, have not been impleaded herein, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks, and is granted, a period of one week for filing an amended Memo of Parties alongwith their affidavit(s)
3.
